item.title: What makes an interview clip get watched? Evidence from 27 accounts and 673 posts
item.dc:creator: AutoClip Team
item.description: We compared 673 posts from 27 accounts, measuring each against its own account's median. Who posts sets most of the reach; inside an account, a live news hook, a speaker with weight and a usable method separate the best post from the worst.

item.title: Pick the moment, not the effect: what 158 short clips taught us about what drives views
item.dc:creator: AutoClip Team
item.description: We logged 158 public short clips and compared high and low performers within the same account. Who or what is in the clip, and where the clip starts, predicted views far better than how it was edited.
